record_scope_reconstruction: The PNG Wutung immigration gate opposite Indonesian Skouw. Initial early-2020 interruption and a later renewed restriction are separate spells, not one uninterrupted pandemic closure.

source_checks.finding: On-site report identifies PNG immigration officers denying entry at Wutung after the Wednesday closure; diplomatic/local-resident cases are discussed.
Governor names Wutung post and travel/business suspension.
October 2022 report identifies PNG Wutung customs reopening for travel to Jayapura; this is later evidence and does not erase the separately accepted February 2020 lifting.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: The PNG Wutung immigration gate opposite Indonesian Skouw. Initial early-2020 interruption and a later renewed restriction are separate spells, not one uninterrupted pandemic closure.

date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification:
EA018-D1: The initial January 29 closure was still preventing ordinary entry in the consul’s February 2 account, reported February 3. The minister said the ban had been lifted by February 11. This supports conservative 4–13 calendar-day difference bounds and a restriction longer than 24 hours, without identifying the exact first restored passage. A February 6 report also allowed approved returning citizens until a deadline inconsistently written February 8/9; this is not general business reopening.

EA018-AUDIT20261025-1: Later reclosure is independently documented in July 2021, but its start and intervening continuity are unknown. The June 21 goods-only opening was postponed and July 21 remained conditional. BNPP reports Wutung–Skouw operation restored October 24, 2022; PNG Customs separately confirms PNG citizens could travel to Jayapura. This does not turn the initial January 2020 spell into a continuous multi-year closure or establish unrestricted entry for all nationalities.

unresolved: Indonesian PLBN Skouw building has been located, but the PNG Wutung gate position was not recovered; opposite-direction terminals cannot be silently merged.
Later phase exact July 2021 last-confirmation content not retrieved in this batch; canonical date remains unchanged.
